# Getting help

## Questions, bugs, and feature requests

Open an issue using the [issue forms](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/2-dof-robotic-arm-control-system/issues/new/choose) for reproducible software bugs, build issues, or feature proposals.

## Security problems

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What is out of scope

- Proprietary MATLAB/Simulink license setup or MathWorks toolbox support (use the open-source GNU Octave and Python verification paths instead).
- Custom hardware wiring debugging beyond the pin tables documented in the sketches and `README.md`.
